::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 18th [1866]  
**From:** Torquay  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Erskine](people/person_489.qmd),
Your letter only came to me this morning as you see I am on my travels - so though it is before Tuesday, I think I had better answer to May. I shall be at 45 Westbourne Terrace for a few days after Wednesday, and shall I hope have a good sight of [Mary Coleridge](people/person_351.qmd) whom I have quite missed in Devonshire[^1]

I have told Ivanova ([Miss Batty](people/person_126.qmd)) of the Institution, and if she will undertake to write an account of it, I will ask you to be kind enough to send the report either to her or to me - but I will let you know what she says -<sup>2</sup>

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Perhaps 'Ivanovna', ‘Convalescent institutions’ *MP* (November 1866) 509-515.
